newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank cuts minimum rate, refinancing offer.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank cuts minimum rate, refinancing offer.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Thursday it had cut the minimum permitted rate for its auctioned funds to 175 percent from 190 percent last week.
The BNR has also slashed the one-week refinancing funds on offer to 200 billion lei from last week's 300 billion.

Dealers saw the rate as being "high" considering the money market coditions but said it might reflect BNR cautiousness in conducting monetary policy following the announcement that monthly inflation hit a record 30.7 percent in March.
The money market stayed overliquid with overnight funds at about 90-95 percent and one-week prices near 110 percent.
